_note: The one list of the common front/back pages, in print order. To drop a page set "enabled": false (or delete its row); to add one, put a new HTML fragment in pages/ and add a row. Nothing else needs to change. Pages of kind 'volume' are not stored here: the embedding script supplies them from the volume (see README.md).
_embed: Master switch for the embedder (publish/printfix.py). false = no volume PDF changes; the user sets true when the pages are ready.
